title: Integrate European compact nibble projection
changes: Extend the compact catalog with the structurally decoded 0–6 selector projection of root 6ca580; unrepresented bytes retain ROM fallback.
validation: Protected EUR Wine source analysis traces the initialized nibble to the callback and identifies 116 represented bytes for selectors 0–6, with no E126 overlap.
Windows GNU build PASS; Wine create/reuse PASS with 99 other resources and 62 previous banks unchanged.
Focused Wine test PASS for 16 nibble values, 116 represented bytes and boundaries, raw fallback, coherent rejection and four sampled native count comparisons with full state and clock.
Wine 12-frame production startup PASS with 100 resource identities; catalog reads were zero.
limitations: Other nibble candidates exceed analysis guards, not guest bounds. Mutable state, other callers, ordinary use, Linux, USA and native Windows remain unverified. No performance measurements.
